title: Axeyum declarative declaration specification (L3 phase D1, ADR-0965)
description: One file describes one subsystem: a set of kernel declarations built from a small typed expression DSL, plus their build phase, dependencies, and evaluation equations. See docs/research/09-decisions/adr-0965-declarative-declaration-spec-pilot.md for the design and TCB argument. This schema is versioned by top-level `spec_version`; a consumer MUST reject a file whose version it does not recognize rather than guess a compatible interpretation.

spec_version.description: Schema version. Bump on any breaking change to the expression DSL or the top-level shape; a consumer must fail closed on an unrecognized version rather than attempt best-effort parsing.

subsystem.description: A short identifier for the subsystem this file describes, e.g. 'nat-squarefree'. Used only for reporting; not itself a kernel name.

prelude.description: Which prelude's namespace convention and dependency set this subsystem builds against. The pilot targets 'nat'.

declarations.description: One entry per kernel declaration, in the exact order they must be admitted. Order in this array IS the build order within this file; combined with `phase` it is checked for a total order across the whole corpus.

local_name.description: The declaration's name within its namespace, e.g. 'squarefreeAux'.

namespace.description: Dotted namespace the name is interned under. Empty string means the bare root namespace (e.g. Mathlib's 'Squarefree', not 'Nat.Squarefree' -- see squarefree.rs's module doc for why this matters for the autogenesis screen).

kind.description: Declaration kind. Only 'Definition' is supported by this pilot's interpreter -- a spec MUST NOT describe a Theorem's proof term (see ADR-0965: the spec/generator boundary keeps proof terms hand-written and kernel-checked exactly as today). A future extension may allow a Theorem's public SIGNATURE (for accessor generation) with an explicit 'proof: hand-written' marker, but no such extension exists yet, and none is implemented here.

phase.description: Topological build-order key. A declaration's `phase` must be >= every non-extern dependency's phase, and dependencies must not form a cycle. Missing or non-integer phase is a hard validation failure.

universe_params.description: Universe parameter names. Empty for the pilot (everything here is Prop/Type 0-level Nat/Bool).

binders.description: Informational: the declaration's leading binder list, for documentation/inventory generation. The actual type is built from `type` below via the same expression DSL; `binders` is not independently interpreted (avoids a second source of truth for the same Pi-chain).

type.description: Expression DSL recipe for the declaration's full type (a chain of arrows over `binders`, ending at the codomain sort).

value.description: Expression DSL recipe for the declaration's value.

mirrors_existing.description: true ONLY for a spec that deliberately describes an already-landed declaration (e.g. a digest-parity pilot comparing generated output against hand-written code). Exempts this declaration from the cross-prelude duplicate guard, which otherwise treats any name already present in the real kernel's name inventory as a collision. A spec proposing genuinely new work MUST NOT set this -- it exists to let one specific, self-documented use case (see nat-squarefree.json) coexist with the guard the Nat.inverseIndex collision motivated, not to silence that guard generally.

name.description: Fully-dotted name, e.g. 'Nat.mul' or 'squarefreeAux' (spec-local, resolved by local_name within this file).

extern.description: true if this dependency is an existing kernel/prelude primitive (exempt from the phase/cycle check against this file's own declarations); false if it must resolve to another `local_name` declared in this same spec (subject to the phase/cycle check).

dependencies.description: Every name this declaration's `type`/`value` recipe references via a `const_ref` node, used for the cycle/phase guard and for generated inventory rows. This is declared data, not re-derived from the expression tree, so the generator can and does cross-check consistency between `dependencies` and the recipe's actual `const_ref` nodes and fails if they disagree.

equations.description: Concrete evaluation checks: reduce the declaration to normal form at these arguments and compare against the given expected output. Required for every Bool/Nat-valued Definition (this crate's CLAUDE.md: 'the trusted gate cannot tell you a Definition is wrong -- only evaluation can').

expr.description: A node in the small expression DSL. `op` selects the constructor; remaining fields are op-specific. See declaration_spec_pilot.rs's `Node`/`parse_node` for the exact op set this pilot's interpreter implements (nat_ty, bool_ty, arrow, lam, var, zero, num, succ, mul, mod, beq, bool_true, bool_false, bool_ite, apply, const_ref, nat_rec). Adding an op here without a matching interpreter arm is a validation-time error, not a silent no-op.
